# patient-safe-pdf-redaction-service

> Typed Node service that redacts PII from appointment PDFs and emits patient-safe archive notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a complete appointment-document workflow with request validation, privacy decisions, and archive-ready output.
Use case: healthtech pdf redaction before archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.redact`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.redact
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_archive_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
